ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area with approximately 2% high-intensity (tan/white) pixel distribution concentrated in localized points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black contiguous field across entire visible fluke area, punctuated by discrete circular high-contrast blobs (barnacles) scattered bilaterally on the ventral surface and dense clusters at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped indentation with a sharp vertex; approximate pixel-calculated angle of 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Primary boundary is smooth to slightly irregular; low-amplitude serrations visible near the median notch and increased irregular topography at the distal tips due to bio-fouling.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature fitted along the trailing edge extending from the median notch to the outer lobe terminal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast tan/yellow clusters (barnacles) distributed in a non-linear pattern across the central and lower regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single distinct horizontal white linear pixel disruption located on the left lobe (viewer's right) approximately 10 pixels from the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense protruding barnacle colonies at the distal tips of both lobes altering the smooth geometric boundary of the fluke.
